scope: Intermittent failure of the first container launch after Prepare Vapor.
symptom: wine explorer /desktop=shell exits with status 1 about 0.1 s after start; Wine logs "nodrv_CreateWindow ... The explorer process failed to start"; second launch always works.

root_cause.step: prefix update before the session (wineboot -h when .update-timestamp != wine.inf mtime)
root_cause.detail: After waiting up to 30 s for Wine processes to exit, the code called ProcessHelper.terminateAllWineProcesses(), which only signals and returns. winedevice.exe survives SIGTERM (the later session cleanup had to force-kill the same pid, e.g. 8737), so the session started while the prefix-update session was still shutting down.

fix: Use ProcessHelper.terminateSessionProcessesAndWait(5000, true): wait for exit, force-kill after 5 s, log survivors.

evidence.device: VaporProbe36A, Android 16/API 36, 4 KB, lavapipe; fresh install + Prepare Vapor + launch container 1 twice per cycle
before: target 35 first launch: fail x4 (earlier sessions), pass x4 (later session)
target 28 first launch: pass x1 (earlier session), fail x2 (this session)

after.target 28: 3 cycles: first launches 13/13/13 processes up, second launches 13/13/13

evidence.log_after: prefix update: wine processes still alive; terminating them -> Session process cleanup finished with no remaining Wine/session processes -> Guest process started

side_results: No state persists across uninstall (/sdcard/Vapor and /sdcard/wrapper contain only empty directories).
libvapor_exec.so gained VAPOR_EXEC_FORCE=1 (diagnostic: take the linker route even where direct exec works); ExecShimDeviceTest 9/9 at target 28.
With the race fixed, target 35 with the shim boots the Wine desktop on first and second launches.
limitations: Small sample (4 first launches after the fix); intermittent races need the phone pass and field data to confirm.
